answer: Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded juniper account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The vine explorer shows the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
